title: Bug Hunt: Off by One
reference: while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate radio } } def LEDGER { forward forward F1 F1 forward } def F1 { listen forward forward }
hints: Run it and watch where LEDGER waits for the first call.
LEDGER waits one tile too early, so it walks into the door before it opens. It needs one more forward at the start.
while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate radio } } def LEDGER { forward forward F1 F1 forward } def F1 { listen forward forward }

story.intro: LEDGER: "Someone has edited my procedure. This is the worst crime committed in this building tonight. Including the heist."
